claim: An Omarchy Agent launch can distinguish a missing transport, route, DNS or remote-service failure without mutating radio state.
oracle: The probe reports one active default-route transport, an IPv4 or IPv6 address, DNS results and HTTPS status for GitHub, the Claude Code GitHub Release endpoint, Anthropic and npm; a link or service failure is named and retried within the configured bound.

user_journey.scenario: The user opens an Agent while Wi-Fi is unavailable, then reconnects over Wi-Fi, USB-shared internet or cellular data.
user_journey.expected: The user gets an actionable layer-specific result and can retry the Agent without entering credentials into the diagnostic tool.

invariants: The probe is read-only: it does not call NetworkManager, wpa_supplicant, ModemManager or a partition tool.
Output contains transport names and public endpoint hosts only; no SSID, MAC, password, IMEI or full route is printed.
A bounded retry cannot loop forever and a failed endpoint does not get reported as reachable.
gitnexus: The package install boundary stages the same probe used by the host tools copy.
No boot, modem, calibration or slot-success path imports the probe.
ast: The script has no write calls and only invokes ip, getent, curl, cat, awk and sleep.
HTTP 2xx-4xx proves transport reachability while 000/5xx remains a failure.

unit.red: The package had no Agent-specific probe and the mise failure could not be separated into route, DNS or HTTPS layers.
unit.green: Fixtures cover Wi-Fi success with an authenticated HTTP response, bounded HTTPS retry failure and output redaction.
cases: Wi-Fi, USB or cellular interface name classification

boundaries: normal Omarchy desktop -> default route -> resolver -> public Agent service host
evidence: Offline fixtures and package test pass; Pixel 6 cold-desktop execution remains pending.

limitations: The probe cannot establish a SIM bearer or repair missing kernel firmware.
A successful HTTP response does not prove authenticated Agent API access or that GitHub has not rate-limited the caller.
No phone was connected for this checkpoint.
exit_gate: Run the probe after a cold normal Omarchy boot on the Pixel 6, then repeat after a controlled Wi-Fi reconnect and one Agent API request.
